editions.lead_headline: Walmart Cracks Open CTV Data, Routes VIZIO Audiences To Yahoo DSP
editions.lead_dek: Magnite-piped integration ends single-DSP exclusivity on Walmart's first-party shoppers and brings closed-loop sales to a second buying surface.

editions.lead_headline: PubMatic Names MiQ Among First Partners In AI-In-The-Auction Layer
editions.lead_dek: Decision Fabric lets approved buy-side models run as Docker containers inside AgenticOS bid requests, returning segment IDs in under ten milliseconds.

editions.lead_headline: Roku Explores Sale as $19B Ad Platform Draws Bidders
editions.lead_dek: Stock jumps more than 20% on reports of a strategic-options review, including a full sale.

editions.lead_headline: Fox to Buy Roku for $22 Billion, Redrawing CTV
editions.lead_dek: The buyer the market was waiting for is a broadcaster: Fox lands the No. 1 US streaming OS, the OneView DSP, Tubi and The Roku Channel.

editions.lead_headline: Fox Bought Roku for Its Identity Graph, Not Its Shows
editions.lead_dek: Three days on, the market reads the $22 billion deal as a play for ACR data, 100 million households and the home screen itself.

editions.lead_headline: Walmart Buys Vibe.co for $1.4B to Pull SMBs Into Streaming
editions.lead_dek: The retailer's largest ad-tech deal yet pairs a self-serve CTV platform with Vizio screens and Walmart's commerce data — a direct answer to Amazon.
